title: Improper Neutralization of Input During Web Page Generation ('Cross-site Scripting') vulnerability in bPlugins…
description: A stored cross-site scripting (XSS) vulnerability exists in bPlugins StreamCast through version 2.4.6 due to improper neutralization of input during web page generation. This vulnerability allows an attacker with low privileges to inject malicious scripts that can be executed in the context of other users. The flaw impacts confidentiality, integrity, and availability to a limited extent. No patch information is currently provided.
